exercise.name: Dumbbell Jefferson Curl

reference.title: Dumbbell Jefferson Curl (male)
reference.listing: Video; data sheet: body part Hips, equipment Dumbbell, exercise type Strength

exercise.mechanics: Compound (segmental spinal flexion and hip hinge)

breathing.pattern: Breathe out slowly as you roll down, breathe gently in the stretch, breathe in as you roll up.
breathing.cadence: About 5 s down, 1.5 s stretch, 3.5 s up

prescription.load: User-chosen, light dumbbells; start with bodyweight and add load slowly over weeks (clinical opinion)
prescription.progression: Range first, then small load increases

cues.text: Stand tall on a box, toes at the front edge, knees straight, light dumbbells in front of the thighs.
Chin to chest first, then roll down one vertebra at a time: upper back, lower back, then the hips.
Hang relaxed with the dumbbells below the box top; breathe into the stretch.
Roll up from the bottom: hips first, then lower back, upper back, and the head last.
Stand tall, shoulders back, then repeat slowly.

mistakes.fix: Use a light load and build up over weeks.

mistakes.mistake: Bending the whole back at once (just folding at the hips)
mistakes.fix: Peel down segment by segment, head first.
Keep the knees straight but not locked.
Take about 5 seconds down and 4 up.

kinematics.norm: Full, comfortable spinal flexion reached segment by segment (Yona 2026 lowered to maximum comfortable flexion; no angles reported)
The hips fold after the spine has rolled down (clinical opinion)
Slow: about 5 s down and 4 s up (clinical opinion)

sources.title: GymVisual #732912, Dumbbell Jefferson Curl (male), video (movement reference)
Yona, Kalifa, Gildar, Margi, Har-Nir & Fischer 2026, surface EMG characterization of the Jefferson curl at a submaximal load matched to the Romanian deadlift (Int J Sports Phys Ther 21(11):1100-1116)

cautions: Stop if sharp pain, numbness, tingling or giving-way occurs.
The dumbbell load is your choice: pick a weight you can move with the form shown for every rep.
Muscle glow colours and activation curves are illustrative, not measured EMG.
Not for anyone with current back pain, a recent disc problem or osteoporosis without medical advice; Yona 2026 studied pain-free trained adults only.
Stand on a solid box that cannot tip.
modify: New to it: do it from the floor without weight first.
Dizziness: come up slowly and stop the set.
regressions: Bodyweight Jefferson curl from the floor.

muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_r: Control the spine as it flexes one segment at a time and extend it back up; upper and lower erector spinae were more active than in a load-matched RDL (about 63% and 60% vs 45% and 48% MVIC, Yona 2026).
muscleNotes.spinal_extensors_l: Control the spine as it flexes one segment at a time and extend it back up; upper and lower erector spinae were more active than in a load-matched RDL (about 63% and 60% vs 45% and 48% MVIC, Yona 2026).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_r: Stretched at the bottom with the knees straight; biceps femoris was more active than in the load-matched RDL (about 54% vs 42% MVIC, Yona 2026).
muscleNotes.hamstrings_l: Stretched at the bottom with the knees straight; biceps femoris was more active than in the load-matched RDL (about 54% vs 42% MVIC, Yona 2026).
muscleNotes.glute_max_r: Extends the hips on the way up; activity similar to the RDL (about 31% MVIC, Yona 2026).
muscleNotes.glute_max_l: Extends the hips on the way up; activity similar to the RDL (about 31% MVIC, Yona 2026).
muscleNotes.core: Controls the roll; no bracing against the flexion.
